title: docs(adr): ADR-0150 keeps the scorer's prefix check on positions (review round 10)
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XBsDxUffG35RvTHueTQ8ZGa)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把 #31586 进入合并队列时尚未推送的最后一轮审查（6727093622：S19 和 N26–N29）补进已合并的 ADR-0150。只改这一个 ADR 文件的三行文字，不改代码。
- 为什么改：S19 是实质修正：场景评分器的前缀检查对「职位」也要保留。职位在整个环境里同名只有一个槽位（D7），两个画廊应用的同名职位在安装时仍会冲突。其余是措辞：评分器保留检查的集合（view、doc、capability，capability 按 NS.SHORT 拼法）；评分器的交接「与 P 同时或在 P 之前」落地；技能文字改为「不再给 2–4 档的名字加前缀」；ADR-0048 §5 的 lint 条目和 §3.4 的 lint 句子挂到子卡 A。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档，没有运行时风险。回滚即撤销这一个提交。
- 先看：ADR-0150 D9 的「Narrowed to bucket 1 and positions」一句。
- 两分钟验证：运行 pnpm check:adr-index 和 node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs，两条都应退出 0。
- 需要你做的：审阅后合并。

## What changes

- `docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md`, 3 lines:
  - D9: the scenario scorer's `bare-name` Build check and its build prompt are narrowed to bucket 1 types **and positions**. A position is one environment-wide slot (D7), so a bare position from two gallery apps still collides at install (S19). Of the collections the scorer walks, view, doc and capability keep the check, the capability by its `NS.SHORT` spelling, and an api item's name is bucket 2 (N26). The hand-off lands with or before P (N27). The skills stop prefixing bucket 2–4 names (N28).
  - The plan's hand-off line matches D9.
  - Child A's row names ADR-0048 §5's `[done]` lint bullet and §3.4's lint sentence, which go stale after P and the phase-3 withdrawal (N29).

## Tests

None. This is a docs-only amendment (`skip-changeset`).
